instant diagnosis — no AI tokens needed
# A Service that routes to nothing — the #1 cause of 503s
Backing pods: 0 match the selector, 0 Ready.
- Selector matches 0 pods — the Service black-holes traffic. Compare its selector with the labels on
the pod template (a common typo: app vs app.kubernetes.io/name).
# Missing Secret & ConfigMap — invisible in the logs
- ConfigMap "app-config" is referenced but does not exist — the pod cannot start (CreateContainerC
- Secret "db-credentials" is referenced but does not exist — the pod cannot start (CreateContainer
ConfigError or ImagePullBackOff for pull secrets).
# A bad rollout, pinned to the exact revision & image
- revision 2: 1 running pods, age 7m48s, images: nginx=nginx:nonexistent-tag
- revision 1: 1 running pods, age 8m11s, images: nginx=nginx:1.25
- Latest rollout (revision 2) changed container "nginx" image: nginx:1.25 → nginx:nonexistent-tag.
If the problem started recently, this is the prime suspect — `kubectl rollout undo` to revision 1 r
- Revisions 2, 1 all have running pods — the rollout is in progress or stuck; the newest revision'
s pods are likely failing their probes.
